description: This file is a comprehensive PHP web page for managing local IP configurations on a network gateway, including IPv4 and IPv6 settings, with embedded JavaScript for dynamic UI updates and validation.

methods.name: setIPconfiguration
methods.description: Sends the new IPv4 configuration via AJAX to the server for update.

methods.name: setIPv6configuration
methods.description: Sends the new IPv6 configuration via AJAX to the server for update.

methods.name: calcuate_lease_time
methods.description: Calculates the lease time in seconds based on user input and unit specified.

methods.name: display_time_format
methods.description: Formats and displays the lease time in a human-readable form for IPv4.

methods.name: display_time_format_V6
methods.description: Formats and displays the lease time in a human-readable form for IPv6.

methods.name: populateIPv6Addr
methods.description: Parses an IPv6 address string into an array of segments.

methods.name: updateIPv6
methods.description: Updates the UI elements based on whether IPv6 is set to Stateless or Stateful.

methods.name: validate_v4addr_pool
methods.description: Validates that DHCP start and end addresses are in correct order.

methods.name: validate_v6addr_pool
methods.description: Validates that IPv6 DHCP starting address is not larger than ending address.
